verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a first-party S3-compatible adapter for its filesystems, so standard tools like rclone and s5cmd can copy files out. Instances run standard Ubuntu with SSH and root access, and there are no long-term commitments, which makes moving data and leaving feasible. It is still a file-copy path rather than a documented whole-account export or offboarding feature. Missing for 10: a documented export of all account data (instances, metadata, usage, config), offboarding/data-deletion guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of migrating off.
